target.title: ci: reuse one package in QA smoke
target.body:
Related: #99767

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where QA Smoke CI could exhaust its Node heap while each nested scenario independently rebuilt the full OpenClaw package. The same failure reproduced on the synced macOS onboarding PR and on `main`.

## Why This Change Was Made

Build one validated package tarball at the start of QA Smoke CI, export it through the existing `OPENCLAW_CURRENT_PACKAGE_TGZ` contract, and let every nested script and Docker scenario reuse that artifact. Run this memory-heavy lane on the existing 8-vCPU Blacksmith class while preserving manual-dispatch and fork fallbacks.

## User Impact

No product behavior changes. Maintainers get a stable QA smoke gate without repeated full-package builds or the observed approximately 7 GB `tsdown` heap failure.

## Evidence

- Before: QA Smoke CI failed after three attempts on PR #99767 in [workflow run 28692540236](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28692540236).
- Before: the same package-build OOM reproduced on `main` in [workflow run 28692803354](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28692803354).
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/ci-workflow-guards.test.ts` — 33 tests passed.
- `node scripts/check-workflows.mjs` — workflow validation passed.
- `pnpm docs:check-mdx` — 690 files passed.
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- Fresh Codex autoreview — zero accepted or actionable findings; overall correctness 0.95.

AI-assisted: yes. I reviewed the implementation and validation results. A transcript is not attached because the source session also contains unrelated authenticated live-test work.
